item.title: Bulletin updated at 02:45 HKT 26/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the persistent influence of an intense northeast monsoon and its replenishment, temperatures will fall progressively over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days, and the weather will become fine and dry. It will be cool in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. With the monsoon moderating, temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly early next week. A dry easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southern China early next week.

Date/Month: 26/11 (Tuesday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Relatively cool in the morning and at night. Mainly cloudy. One or two showers at first. Dry with sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 18 - 23 C
R.H. range: 55 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
